identificationModule.briefTitle: IC Plus Low-dose Radiation Plus Cadonilimab in LANPC
identificationModule.officialTitle: Induction Chemotherapy Combined With Low-dose Radiation Plus Cadonilimab in Loco-regionally Advanced Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma: a Multi-center, Open-label, Randomized Controlled Phase III Clinical Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a multi-center, open-label, randomized controlled phase III clinical trial in primary diagnosed loco-regionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) patients. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of induction chemotherapy (IC) combined with low-dose radiation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT) versus IC+CCRT, and compare the treatment-related adverse events and quality of life in two groups.

armGroups.label: Low-dose RT plus ICI
armGroups.description: Patients will receive induction chemotherapy plus low-dose radiotherapy and immuce checkpoint inhibitor then followed by concurrent chemoradiotehrapy.

armGroups.label: IC+CCRT
armGroups.description: Patients will receive induction chemotherapy plus concurrent chemoradiotehrapy.

interventions.name: Intensity Modulated Radiation Therapy
interventions.description: All target volumes will be outlined slice by slice on the axial contrast-enhanced CT with MR fusion images in the treatment planning system. The target volumes are defined in accordance with the International Commission on Radiation Units and Measurements Reports 83. The prescribed dose is 70-72 Gy to PTVp (Planning target volume of the primary tumor), 64-70 Gy to PTVn (Planning target volume of the lymph node), 60- 64Gy to PTV1 (High-risk planning target volume), and 54-58 Gy to PTV2 (Low-risk planning target volume) in 30-32 fractions.

interventions.name: Chemotherapy
interventions.description: Induction chemotherapy: gemcitabine and cisplatin, Q3W, 3 cycles Concurrent chemotherapy: cisplatin, Q3W, 2-3 cycles

interventions.name: Low-dose radiotherapy
interventions.description: Low-dose radiotherapy will be performed to study group, with the use of IMRT.

primaryOutcomes.description: From the date of randomization to local or regional recurrence, distant metastasis or any death

secondaryOutcomes.description: From the date of randomization to any death, with patients unavailable for follow-up censored at the date of last follow-up
From the date of randomization to local recurrence or any death
From the date of randomization to regional recurrence or any death
From the date of randomization to distant metastasis or any death

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the start of treatment until 3 months post treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: Assessed with EORTC-Quality of life questionnaire-C30 version 3.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Through study completion, an average of 3 years
